# Dissociated IdentiTea

Dissociated IdentiTea is an altered-thinking-space design with light and dark modes and multiple expressive subthemes. Rainbow and accent colors are customizable through Style Settings, and the theme adds custom callouts, including a Creative callout, together with expressive checkboxes.

![Dissociated IdentiTea screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7eahaus/dissociated-identitea/HEAD/screenshots/darkmode-overview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Dissociated IdentiTea"
    author: "TeaHaus Shindan"
    repo:   "7eahaus/dissociated-identitea"
    slug:   "dissociated-identitea"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/dissociated-identitea"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7eahaus/dissociated-identitea/HEAD/screenshots/darkmode-overview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Explore Dissociated IdentiTea's altered-thinking-space design with light and dark modes and multiple expressive subthemes. Customize rainbow and accent colors via Style Settings and use custom callouts (including a Creative callout) and expressive checkboxes to organize ideas and tasks."
}
```
